verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents a first-party Administration REST API and the kcadm.sh Admin CLI for scripted administration of realms, users, roles and clients. The SCIM docs also refer to managing resources 'through the Admin Console or the Admin REST API,' which implies broad programmatic coverage. However, no evidence explicitly states that every admin-console and account-console action has an API equivalent. Hands-on users also report inconsistent API behavior (incomplete GET payloads, POST not saving) that hampers idempotent automation. missing for 10: explicit documented UI-to-API parity guarantee, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent corroboration of consistent, complete API behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
